findings.description: The enabled flag is only checked by decorator wrappers, so direct calls through Retrying or AsyncRetrying still retry when enabled=False.
findings.rationale: For example, Retrying(enabled=False, stop=stop_after_attempt(3))(f), where f raises a retryable exception, still executes f three times because the retry controller's __call__ path never checks enabled. Users of the direct controller API therefore cannot disable retries with the newly accepted parameter; the same omission affects iterator-based retry loops.
